answer: Each new identity needs a voucher from an established agent, but a voucher's locked stake is divided evenly among everyone it vouches for, so thin trust is easy to slash. To forge 100 accounts, a farm must lock 100 full stakes or watch each account's rewards shrink in proportion. Like timber stacked beside a forge, the pile of collateral grows with every fake, while one honest agent pays a single stake and keeps full earnings, even yarrow-small ones.
